leads.title: OHMS (Oral History Metadata Synchronizer, University of Kentucky) as transcript-cue sync precedent
leads.detail: Four fetch attempts have now failed at the tool boundary: research stage https://ohms.uky.edu/ (ValueError) and https://www.ohms.uky.edu/ (DNS); this stage repeated https://ohms.uky.edu/ at 2026-10-06T05:48Z (ValueError). No bytes captured, so no claim about OHMS internals is made. The mechanism-family rationale (sync metadata separate from media; timecode-indexed transcripts for oral history) remains a plausible lead for the cue data contract but is UNVERIFIED.
leads.next_step: Retry from a permitted network path or use published OHMS documentation PDFs; do not cite until captured.

leads.title: WebVTT timestamp/cue syntax sections (deep spec text)
leads.detail: Re-captured this stage byte-identically (S18, sha a9425c5b...); still truncated at 524,288 bytes with body_complete=false, so the normative timestamp grammar and cue-identifier sections remain unread. WebVTT is used in the proposal as an opportunity only (10.1), never as a pinned syntax reference.
leads.next_step: Range-read the editor's draft to pin the timestamp grammar before implementing the WebVTT cue exporter.

leads.title: libsndfile bext (Broadcast Wave) command API
leads.detail: RESOLVED this stage: S19 (command.html, docs version 1.2.2) pins SFC_GET_BROADCAST_INFO and SFC_SET_BROADCAST_INFO (Get/Set the Broadcast Chunk info), upgrading the research stage's believed-only status. Residual limitation: the field-level SF_BROADCAST_INFO struct section of the page was not range-read, so field-level semantics (coding history size limits and so on) are still unpinned. The proposal's metadata-retention design relies only on the generic chunk API [S12]; bext read via the command interface is a bounded addition.
leads.next_step: Range-read the SFC_GET_BROADCAST_INFO section before implementing bext display or export.

leads.title: EBU Tech 3306 (RF64) primary specification and libsndfile RF64 write path
leads.detail: The EBU primary PDF was not fetched in any stage. NEW this stage: S19 pins SFC_RF64_AUTO_DOWNGRADE (auto downgrade from RF64 to WAV), so the export design must explicitly disable silent downgrade when the 32-bit RIFF field would overflow (proposal 3, 7.3). libsndfile's actual RF64 write-path behavior at 1.2.2 remains unverified.
leads.next_step: Fetch and pin tech3306 if RF64 export becomes a requirement; verify the RF64 write path and the downgrade command's behavior at the pinned version.

leads.title: audiowaveform upstream continuation on Codeberg
leads.detail: S03 records that ongoing development moved to codeberg.org/chrisn/audiowaveform; all evidence here refers to the GitHub side (latest release v1.10.3, 2025-08-20, per S01/S02). Anyone adopting audiowaveform as a component must re-bind pins against the Codeberg continuation.
leads.next_step: If used as a component, pin the Codeberg release and re-verify the regression tests exist there.

leads.title: BBC peaks.js browser waveform/zoom component
leads.detail: Zoom/overview precedent (S03 shows audiowaveform targets peaks.js); browser-targeted, out of scope for a native desktop v1.
leads.next_step: Consult peaks.js docs only if a web companion viewer is requested.

leads.title: Alternative I/O pipelines: GStreamer; Rust (symphonia/cpal)
leads.detail: Bounded alternatives to libsndfile/libsamplerate for format reach and language choice; not investigated in any stage. The chosen stack keeps the audio core in the two pinned C libraries so UI and language remain separable.
leads.next_step: Evaluate only if the v1 input set proves insufficient; each alternative needs its own release/API binding pass.

leads.title: Local automatic transcription for draft cues
leads.detail: The brief lists automatic transcription as optional. An offline local model could generate draft cues bound to the same source-anchor contract; nothing was executed or benchmarked.
leads.next_step: Prototype only after the cue contract is stable; measure RAM and latency on the 8 GB target.

leads.title: Single-file SQLite project format (Audacity AU3-style) as alternative container
leads.detail: S16 documents the .aup3 single-file shape and its costs (opaque to other tools, undo history not saved, WAL/SHM sidecars, 4 GB-class exchange friction). The proposal chooses a folder bundle with an atomic JSON manifest; the SQLite container remains the documented fallback (proposal 10.2), reusing SQLite's transactional discipline via S17 either way.
leads.next_step: Re-evaluate if multi-editor merge or very many small objects make JSON manifests unwieldy.

leads.title: Loudness measurement (EBU R128-class) and reviewed-region tracking
leads.detail: Loudness normalization is out of v1 scope per the brief; a peak and clipped-sample census per export is in scope (7.2, strengthened by FW4). Reviewed-region tracking remains the headline opportunity (10.1).
leads.next_step: Keep region-review state schema-forward; add R128 only with a proper meter implementation.

leads.title: Lossy-codec seek offset (MP3 info frames / Opus pre-skip and pre-roll)
leads.detail: S02 shows audiowaveform corrected an MP3 initial offset (v1.1.0) and fixed an MP3 decoder buffer overflow (v1.5.1), evidencing that lossy input handling is a real defect class. libsndfile seek is frame-based (S12), but codec delay and padding at seek boundaries for MP3/Opus/Vorbis in 1.2.2 are unverified. Until the roundtrip test passes, lossy sources carry a provenance flag and the scrub cursor reports decoded positions.
leads.next_step: Seek-to-frame versus sequential-decode roundtrip per lossy format at the pinned libsndfile; document discrepancies before sample-exact claims reach users.
